title: Career Roadmap · Tool & Die Maker
summary: A Tool & Die Maker designs, manufactures, assembles and maintains precision tools, dies, jigs and fixtures used to produce components in high-volume manufacturing.

facts.Course: Fitter / Turner / Machinist / Tool & Die Maker

blocks.text: Primary pathway
Core work
Precision machining • Die assembly • Jigs and fixtures • Engineering drawings • Metrology • Tool maintenance.

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10 with Mathematics and Science; check the current trade-specific entry rules.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science in Classes 11–12 is useful but not always necessary for the ITI route.

blocks.label: Admission
blocks.text: State ITI counselling or institute-specific admission, depending on the provider.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Mechanical drawing, workshop practice, machining, metalworking and precision measurement.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Geometry, spatial reasoning, accuracy, safe tool handling and basic computer skills.

rows.text: Dies, moulds, toolrooms and precision tooling
Milling, turning, grinding and precision components
Assembly, fitting, alignment and tool maintenance
Broader manufacturing, tooling and production roles

blocks.label: Alternative route
blocks.text: Class 10 → Mechanical Engineering diploma → Tool design / manufacturing roles, depending on employer requirements and further training.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Engineering drawings, workshop safety, hand tools, measurement and basic machining.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Toolmaking
blocks.text: Milling, turning, grinding, fitting, heat treatment and precision measurement.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced skills
blocks.text: Die design concepts, jigs and fixtures, CNC machining, CAD/CAM and dimensional inspection.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Tool assembly, troubleshooting, practical projects, apprenticeship applications and trade assessments.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Make a simple drill jig • Manufacture a precision punch and die component • Assemble and check a small fixture • Measure a machined component against a technical drawing.

The DGT lists Tool & Die Maker (Dies & Moulds) and Tool & Die Maker (Press Tools, Jigs & Fixtures) as two-year ITI trades (2,400 hours), with Class 10 Science and Mathematics or an accepted equivalent as the listed entry qualification.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Automotive, aerospace, consumer products, plastics, metal stamping, electronics and precision engineering.

blocks.label: Employer types
blocks.text: Manufacturing plants, component suppliers, toolrooms, industrial workshops and engineering service firms.

blocks.label: Technical skills
blocks.text: Engineering drawing interpretation, precision fitting, machining, die assembly, tolerances, measurement, troubleshooting and workplace safety.

blocks.label: Tools / technologies
blocks.text: Milling machines, lathes, surface grinders, vernier calipers, micrometers, gauges, CAD/CAM software and CNC machines.
Useful credentials / training:

items.text: DGT / NCVT-recognized Tool & Die Maker trade certificate.

CAD/CAM, CNC and metrology training from recognized providers.
Advanced instructor training only if pursuing vocational teaching and meeting entry criteria.
